newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 20.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ivorian customs target 601 billion CFA francs revenue in 1997; in first 11 months of 1996 they have raised just over 497.6 billion CFA against an annual target of 585.5 billion CFA.

- Ivorian government and Canadian firm Falconbridge Limited sign deal on mining and processing nickel in northern Touba-Biankouma region; Falconbridge vice-president Paul Severin says company to invest almost 500 billion CFA of which 3.5 billion in the coming year.
- Government decision to halt felling of trees above 8th parallel throws more than 1,000 people out of work in timber industry

- Security Minister Marcel Dibonan Kone says during visit to Abidjan's Port-Bouet district foreign nationals to blame in large part for wave of violent crime in Ivory Coast. - French charter airline Nouvelles Frontieres launches new service from Paris to Abidjan via Lyon.
